headline: ZEROBASEONE to return Jan 18 with new album
sub: Comeback announced on stage at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS
caption:
ZEROBASEONE will return with a new album on Jan 18, 2027.

The group announced the release date during their performance on Day 2 of the 2026 MAMA AWARDS in Osaka on Nov 21, where they also won Favorite Dance & Vocal Performance Group. "We'll come back looking even better," they said. It will be their first release since the 6th mini album 'Ascend-' in May.

📌 Source: Joy News 24 (via Korean media), Soompi
